text.zh: 一切指令的源头：大脑。860 亿个神经元只占体重的 2%，却消耗全身 20% 的能量。
text.en: Every command starts in the brain — 86 billion neurons, 2% of your weight, 20% of your energy.

text.zh: 把大脑收起来，颅底正中就露出一颗豌豆大的垂体——它用激素远程指挥生长、代谢与生殖，是内分泌的总开关。
text.en: Tuck the brain away and a pea-sized gland is left sitting in the floor of the skull: the pituitary, commanding growth, metabolism and reproduction by hormone alone.

text.zh: 视神经像两条"视频电缆"，各由一百多万根纤维组成，把眼睛拍到的世界实时传回大脑。
text.en: The optic nerves are twin video cables — over a million fibers each, streaming the world to your brain.

text.zh: 指令沿脊髓一路向下。它从不裸奔：一节节椎骨在它周围搭成一条骨头隧道，你能看到脊髓正从这条隧道里穿过去。
text.en: Commands run down the spinal cord — and it never travels exposed. The vertebrae stack into a bone tunnel around it, and you can watch the cord threading straight through.

text.zh: 脊髓也不是一根均质的电缆：颈段管手臂、胸段管躯干、腰段管腿、骶段管盆底——信号从哪一节离开，就决定了它落在身体的哪一块。
text.en: The cord is not one uniform cable: the cervical segment serves the arms, the thoracic the trunk, the lumbar the legs, the sacral the pelvic floor — where a signal leaves decides where in the body it lands.
